item.title: Teaching an AI to Run My Chalet While I'm at the Beach
item.description: CastorOS is the platform I’ve been building to automate the boring, repetitive parts of running an Airbnb: door codes, thermostats, guest messages, the works. The big idea is simple: you should be able to go off-grid for a weekend, phone dead, no bars, and not worry that a guest is standing at your door with no idea how to get in.
